say:1:1130979001:1.text: That's right. The last time I went out hiding, my sister brought me back by the ear.
say:1:1130979001:1.source_cn: 是啊，我上次躲在部落附近，就被我姐拧着耳朵抓回去了。

say:2:1130979002:1.text: Don't know what lies those outsiders fed them, but now everyone's gone crazy with treasure hunting.
say:2:1130979002:1.source_cn: 也不知道那些外面来的商人给他们灌了什么迷魂药，非要大伙...

say:3:1130979003:1.text: I guess... besides me, all the other younglings are out there now.
say:3:1130979003:1.source_cn: 我估摸着……除了我之外，部落里的年轻人应该都去了吧？

say:4:1130979004:1.text: That makes me a rebel, doesn't it? Ha!
say:4:1130979004:1.source_cn: 这么一想……我还真是叛逆啊！哈哈！
